However, a competent reader could read this as purely metaphorical desperation. Borderline — I'll fold it into the track finding rather than call it separately.

The sentence reads as one side of a two-sided structure (suppression → result) where the suppression half is missing. However, the sentence still parses and conveys that the official record was simplified. A reader understands that the case was kept simple; they just don't know how. Catherine is an authorized removal, so this is an authorized-cut residue. Not a finding.
